Unpaused is home to Worldloom and TacticStrike: two original games you can play online without installing a game launcher. Build your next world, or jump into a tactical battle.

Aurora

3D space maze · only on Unpaused

Guide a small astronaut across floating crystal islands and, in Chapter 2, a living jungle island. Collect three star shards to wake the portal, dodge lasers, drones and insects, dash through gaps, and hunt for hidden relics. Full controller support.

Aurora guide & controls →

Worldloom

Voxel survival & building

Gather resources, craft tools, and explore forests, oceans, and underground caves. Choose Wayfarer for survival or Dreamweaver to build freely and fly. Save your worlds to your account and invite one friend to share a world.

Worldloom guide & controls →

TacticStrike

Top-down tactical shooter

Move through the map, use cover, and aim with your mouse. Play online battles or practise against bots before your next match. Your account keeps your username consistent across the hub and the game.

TacticStrike guide & controls →

More to play on Unpaused: race anti-gravity ships in HexGL, merge tiles in 2048, and spin the hexagon in Hextris. Open-source browser classics, credited to their creators.

Before you jump in

Are the games free to play?

Yes. You can play Worldloom and TacticStrike for free in your browser. TacticStrike also has an optional credit shop.

Do I need to download anything?

No game download or launcher is required. Open a game from this page. Use an up-to-date desktop browser with a keyboard and mouse; Worldloom also needs WebGL 2 and hardware acceleration.

Can I play Worldloom with a friend?

Yes. Create an account, share your four-digit friend code, and invite one player when creating a saved world. Either player can join that shared world while the other is offline.

What does an account give me?

Your account holds your username, friend code, Worldloom invites, and up to ten saved worlds. You can manage or delete your worlds from the account panel.
